cold_email.subject: Interest in Daycare Teacher — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear WLW Enterprise Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Daycare Teacher opportunity with WLW Enterprise at WLW Enterprise.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Client Service Representative — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear VCA Animal Hospitals Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Client Service Representative opportunity with VCA Animal Hospitals at VCA Animal Hospitals.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

cold_email.body:
Dear VCA Animal Hospitals Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Client Service Representative opportunity with VCA Animal Hospitals at VCA Animal Hospitals.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Associate Project Design Manager - Central Laboratory Services — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Thermo Fisher Scientific Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Associate Project Design Manager - Central Laboratory Services opportunity with Thermo Fisher Scientific at Thermo Fisher Scientific.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. Celina Lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Research Technician I, Study Services — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Champions Oncology, Inc. Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Research Technician I, Study Services opportunity with Champions Oncology, Inc. at Champions Oncology, Inc..

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Client Service Coordinator — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Banfield Pet Hospital Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Client Service Coordinator opportunity with Banfield Pet Hospital at Banfield Pet Hospital.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

Dear Banfield Pet Hospital Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Client Service Coordinator - 002344 opportunity with Banfield Pet Hospital at Banfield Pet Hospital.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Client Service Coordinator - 000583 — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Banfield Pet Hospital Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Client Service Coordinator - 000583 opportunity with Banfield Pet Hospital at Banfield Pet Hospital.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Westerville Client Service Coordinator — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Banfield Pet Hospital Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Westerville Client Service Coordinator opportunity with Banfield Pet Hospital at Banfield Pet Hospital.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Non-Certified Snowboard Instructor, Winter 26-27 — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear June Mountain Ski Area Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Non-Certified Snowboard Instructor, Winter 26-27 opportunity with June Mountain Ski Area at June Mountain Ski Area.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Clinical Research Assistant — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear ECN Clinical Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Clinical Research Assistant opportunity with ECN Clinical at ECN Clinical.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Toddler Teacher — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Lakewood Ranch Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Toddler Teacher opportunity with Lakewood Ranch at Lakewood Ranch.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Behavioral Health Technician — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Behavior and Education (BAE) Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Behavioral Health Technician opportunity with Behavior and Education (BAE) at Behavior and Education (BAE).

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Lab Technician I — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Pace® Analytical Services Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Lab Technician I opportunity with Pace® Analytical Services at Pace® Analytical Services.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

jobs.title: Manager, Analytics Engineering, Data & AI Foundations
jobs.description: POS-33330 Manager, Analytics Engineering, Data & AI Foundations HubSpot's mission is to Help Millions of Organizations Grow Better. HubSpot's Operations team is core to this goal by supporting the HubSpotters who drive growth and serve HubSpot's customers. Our goal in Operations is to embed advanced analytics and algorithmic intelligence into the DNA of decision-making across HubSpot. Flexible, well connected, well architected data are the backbone of our strategy, along with the Analytics Engineers who create that landscape. In this role, you'll join the Data & AI Foundations team and lead Analytics Engineers responsible for the shared data foundations, platform capabilities, and AI enabled workflows that make HubSpot's Analytics Engineering organization more effective and scalable. You'll work across Analytics Engineering managers, analysts, analytics committees, and technical platform partners to understand workflows, identify friction, and turn feedback into a clear strategy and prioritized roadmap. You'll combine people leadership, technical judgment, change management, and hands on problem solving to help the organization adopt new ways of working. In this role, you'll get to: Lead and develop a team of Analytics Engineers, supporting career growth, hiring and retention, regular feedback, and alignment to the highest-impact priorities Set the team's vision and operating model, translating broader Operations and Analytics Engineering goals into a focused roadmap and clear measures of success Partner with Analytics Engineering managers to understand team workflows and identify opportunities to improve composable agents, semantic models, shared data assets, and developer tooling Collaborate with analysts and analytics committees that use shared Analytics Engineering assets or build their own agents, incorporating their feedback into platform strategy and delivery Work with technical leaders to review architecture and implementation approaches, establish scalable standards, and ensure solutions are robust, practical, and reusable Prioritize a portfolio of cross functional initiatives, defining objectives, sequencing, responsibilities, and resource allocation based on impact and team capacity Partner with AI Readiness delivery teams to deploy implementation resources against the highest priority work and remove blockers through execution Own and evolve core platform assets, Analytics Engineering tooling, reusable patterns, and automation that raise the floor for every Analytics Engineer Advance our composable agentic Analytics Engineering delivery system and support responsible adoption of AI-assisted workflows across the organization Guide the development of semantic models and metric layers that serve as trusted, reusable foundations for analytics and AI consumption Establish and champion standards for data modeling, testing, code review, documentation, observability, reliability, and cost management Build enablement programs and cross-functional partnerships that help teams adopt modern tools and practices, while staying close enough to the work to contribute hands-on when it will accelerate progress We are looking for someone with: Experience leading and developing Analytics Engineers or similar technical data professionals, including hiring, coaching, performance management, and career development Demonstrated ability to help define a vision and translate it into a practical strategy, roadmap, and operating model Strong understanding of analysts' workflows and the role of shared data assets, tooling, and standards in improving quality and scale Strong proficiency with SQL, data modeling, ETL, ELT, and modern data tools such as Snowflake, dbt, and Looker Hands-on dbt experience, including scalable modeling patterns, testing, macros, and development workflows Experience building or managing shared data platform assets, developer toolkits, internal frameworks, semantic models, or metric layers Experience with AI assisted development and agentic workflows, such as Claude Code, composable skill based systems, AI agents, or MCP integrations A track record of leading complex, cross-functional data initiatives from an ambiguous problem through production Experience driving change and adoption across a large or complex organization, including influencing without direct authority and building accountability across teams Strong prioritization and project management skills, including defining success criteria, sequencing work, and balancing impact with team capacity A DevOps mindset characterized by automation, collaboration, continuous improvement, reliability, and frequent iteration based on user needs Strong communication skills and the ability to distill technical decisions, trade-offs, and strategy into clear business terms Experience working with globally distributed teams and version control tools such as GitHub Enterprise Cloud Experience with Python is a plus, but not required At HubSpot, we value both flexibility and connection. Whether you’re a Remote employee or work from the Office, we want you to start your journey here by building strong connections with your team and peers. If you are joining our Engineering team, you will be required to attend a regional HubSpot office for in-person onboarding. jobs.title: Associate CQV Engineer
jobs.description: Position Summary The Associate CQV Engineer is responsible for the service and support of laboratory equipment and instrumentation utilized in the Operations laboratory. The scope of support includes installation, calibration, maintenance, and repair of both simple (e.g., plate sealers) and complex (e.g., liquid handling robotics) instrumentation in the laboratory. The Instrument Service Engineer will be the primary point of contact for production lab personnel when equipment and instruments are not operating or not meeting operational specifications. Primary Responsibilities: Work with other Instrument Support Engineers, and the Automation and laboratory teams to respond to instrument failures and ensure proper instrument function. Diagnose and troubleshoot any system concerns to minimize downtime. Install new laboratory equipment (e.g., liquid handlers, sequencers, plate sealers, etc.). Coordinate and/or perform instrument installations and qualifications per equipment protocols. Work with Quality Assurance to determine qualification (IQ/OQ/PQ), calibration and preventive maintenance requirements for new incoming instruments, as needed, to comply with regulations. Maintain program for preventative maintenance (PM), routine maintenance, and calibration of all laboratory equipment. Perform troubleshooting activities and provide Level 1 service; coordinate with Level II’s and vendors to address escalated service concerns. Recommend and implement changes to ensure ongoing high-quality performance of laboratory equipment. Perform all service activities in compliance with all relevant safety and regulatory bodies (e.g., OSHA, CAP, CLIA, etc.). Maintain and continuously develop knowledge and expertise related to the service of clinical laboratory equipment. Track all service activities utilizing system(s) developed in accordance with service procedures and laboratory policies. Ensure all service documentation is complete, timely, and accurate following Good Documentation Practices (GDP). Excellent verbal and written English communication skills. Adaptable, open to change, and the ability to work in ambiguous situations while responding to new information and unexpected circumstances. Strong interpersonal and teamwork skills; ability to easily convey concepts and priorities, as well as an ability to solicit feedback and inputs. Support and comply with the company’s Quality Management System policies and procedures. Coordinate duties with Equipment Technician Perform other tasks as specified by the supervisor/manager This role works with PHI on a regular basis both in paper and electronic form and have access to various technologies to access PHI (paper and electronic) in order to perform the job Employee must complete training relating to HIPAA/PHI privacy, General Policies and Procedure Compliance training and security training as soon as possible but not later than the first 30 days of hire. Must maintain a current status on Natera training requirements. Qualifications: BS/BA in a biological science/biomedical engineering, similar field of study, or comparable industry experience 1 years of industry-related experience. Experience supporting lab equipment or similar required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities: Ability to analyze and problem solve issues Excellent attention to detail and accuracy Ability to promote a positive team environment Adaptability in a frequently-changing environment Normally receives general instructions on routine work, detailed instructions on new projects or assignments Maintain a high level of professionalism and responsibility Must have strong communication, interpersonal and organizational skills Word processing and data management (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.) Preferred skills: Familiar with DNA Isolation and Purification, PCR, Cell Culture, Sequencing, etc. Experience operating automation or sequencing instrumentation. OUR OPPORTUNITY Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives. The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you’ll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you’ll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management. WHAT WE OFFER Competitive Benefits - Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program! For more information, visit www.natera.com . Natera is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace environment, and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives. Inclusive collaboration benefits our employees, our community and our patients, and is critical to our mission of changing the management of disease worldwide. All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply, and will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, age, veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable laws. If you are based in California, we encourage you to read this important information for California residents. Link: https://www.natera.com/notice-of-data-collection-california-residents/ Please be advised that Natera will reach out to candidates with a @ natera.com email domain ONLY. Email communications from all other domain names are not from Natera or its employees and are fraudulent. Natera does not request interviews via text messages and does not ask for personal information until a candidate has engaged with the company and has spoken to a recruiter and the hiring team. Natera takes cyber crimes seriously, and will collaborate with law enforcement authorities to prosecute any related cyber crimes. cold_email.subject: Interest in Associate CQV Engineer — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Natera Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Associate CQV Engineer opportunity with Natera at Natera.

I am especially interested in building scalable data systems that let research and clinical teams use biological data reliably. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, I have built API-driven and Snakemake-based pipelines, automated SQL workflows, and worked across both scientific and software contexts.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin

jobs.title: Order Resolution Program Manager
jobs.description: Positition: The Order Resolution Program Manager builds and leads the Order Resolution Program (ORP), a national program that helps ensure patients receive the testing their physicians have ordered. When an order encounters a barrier, such as an unreachable patient, an incorrect phone number, a patient with unanswered questions about their test, or a step that requires clinic involvement, this role makes sure the right people take the right action so care is not delayed. Many of these patients are navigating a cancer diagnosis, and the program exists to support them and the Patient Coordinators who care for them. As the program's founding owner , the Program Manager exercises independent judgment to assess the current landscape, resolve complex cases directly, and determine what the program needs to succeed, including whether and how to expand the team. The role is hands-on by design: the Program Manager works open cases alongside Patient Coordinators to understand where and why orders stall, then uses that firsthand insight and program data to set strategy, define standards, and guide leadership decisions. The Program Manager partners across Patient Services, Territory Managers, Clinical Oncology Specialists, Patient Coordinators, Inside Sales Managers, Regional Directors, and Operations Managers, earning alignment through expertise and sound judgment rather than direct authority. Primary Responsibilities: Program Strategy & Ownership Own the Order Resolution Program end-to-end across all national regions, independently assessing the current landscape, including case volume, root causes, regional variation, and existing workflows, to determine where patient orders are most at risk of delay. Develop a data-supported program roadmap and staffing recommendation for Patient Services leadership, including headcount requirements, staffing structure, timeline, and whether process or tooling solutions would better serve patients. Define the program operating model, including case ownership, escalation criteria, service timelines, handoff protocols, and quality standards, and adjust it as the program matures. Lead the design of the team structure, role definitions, hiring profile, onboarding, and performance expectations for future team members. Case Resolution & Patient Care Support Exercise independent judgment to evaluate open ORP cases, determine the root cause of each barrier, and develop a tailored resolution strategy that accounts for the clinical context, the patient's circumstances, and available resources. Work complex and high-priority cases directly, including researching LIMS, paper orders, and patient outreach tools to locate missing or updated contact information, and decide whether a case calls for administrative resolution, clinic education or engagement, or escalation. Partner with Patient Coordinators to support patient outreach, providing guidance on how to approach each case and, where appropriate, connecting with patients directly so that questions about their orders are answered and care can move forward. Determine when to escalate a case to the clinic, engage the field team, or close it, and document the rationale so any subsequent owner can continue seamlessly. Maintain a real-time view of all open cases, including status, owner, next action, and age, and follow up consistently to confirm actions are completed and patients are not left waiting. Analytics & Performance Reporting Design, build, and maintain the ORP reporting infrastructure, including dashboards, KPI scorecards, and regional trend analysis, and define the metrics used to measure program success. Report regularly to Patient Services leadership on case volume, resolution rates, time to resolution, and order completion outcomes, translating data into clear insights about what is working, what is not, and what should change. Analyze recurring barriers, such as common reasons patients cannot be reached or questions that arise repeatedly, and develop recommendations that reduce the number of patients whose orders require intervention in the first place. Cross-Functional Leadership & Process Improvement Partner with Territory Managers, Clinical Oncology Specialists, Associate Clinical Oncology Specialists, and Patient Coordinators to set clear expectations, communicate promptly, and share accountability on every open case. Partner with Inside Sales Managers, Regional Directors, and Operations Managers to align program priorities, resolve regional barriers, and ensure teams understand their role in supporting patient orders. Serve as the subject matter expert for ORP, providing guidance and consultation to field and operations partners and developing best practices, training, and standard work that can be adopted nationally. Identify systemic process gaps and bring structured, data-backed recommendations to leadership, including changes to workflows, status definitions, tooling, and cross-team handoffs, with the patient experience as the guiding lens. Performs other duties as assigned. Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in healthcare administration, business, life sciences, or a related field; or equivalent professional experience in a role requiring independent judgment, program ownership, and decision-making in a healthcare or clinical operations environment. 5 or more years of experience in healthcare operations, patient services, program or project management, or a comparable environment, with demonstrated ownership of a program, workflow, or initiative from assessment through execution. Demonstrated ability to assess a complex operating landscape, identify root causes, and develop and present a data-supported recommendation, including resourcing and staffing needs, to senior leadership. Proven ability to independently assess multi-variable situations and determine the appropriate course of action without direct supervision, particularly in patient-facing or clinically sensitive contexts. Demonstrated ability to influence and drive accountability across cross-functional teams, including field, sales, and operations leaders, without direct authority. Strong analytical capability, including building performance reporting, interpreting trends, and communicating findings clearly to leadership; advanced MS Excel or equivalent skills required. Experience in a call center, patient outreach, or high-volume case management environment (inbound and outbound). Proficiency in CRM platforms, case tracking systems, and data tools; familiarity with skip tracing tools and LIMS is a strong plus. Prior experience leading, coaching, or building a team is preferred. Background in patient coordination or another patient-facing healthcare role is strongly preferred. Knowledge, Skills & Abilities Technical Program and project management expertise, including scoping, planning, prioritization, milestone tracking, and stakeholder management. Specialized knowledge of healthcare operations, patient services workflows, and clinical coordination sufficient to evaluate case scenarios and develop resolution strategies without relying on standardized scripts. Advanced proficiency in CRM platforms, case tracking systems, and reporting tools, with the ability to design KPI dashboards that give leadership real-time visibility into program performance and patient order outcomes. Strong quantitative skills, including comfort working with large data sets to identify trends, build business cases, and model staffing and capacity needs. Experience with skip tracing tools and multi-database research methods, and with process documentation and standard operating procedure development. Behavioral Exercises sound, independent judgment consistently, treating each case and each program decision as a situation requiring individualized analysis. Builds before being asked: sees what a new program needs, takes ownership of the decision, and moves forward without waiting to be told something is off track. Balances urgency and care: moves quickly because patients are waiting, and makes thoughtful decisions because the stakes are real. Thinks like a program owner and acts like a teammate: comfortable working individual cases to learn the work, and equally comfortable stepping back to set strategy and advise leadership. Earns credibility with cross-functional partners through expertise, clear communication, and follow-through, and uses it to drive action across teams they do not directly control. Coaches and develops others, and is ready to build and lead a team as the program grows. Physical Demands & Work Environment: This is a primarily remote position. Occasional on-site attendance may be required for planning sessions, leadership reviews, or business needs. Duties are performed in a home office or professional office setting and require the ability to use a computer keyboard, communicate over the telephone, and read printed and digital material. This role may require working outside standard business hours at times to address time-sensitive case situations or program needs. Travel: Minimal travel required…

cold_email.body:
Dear Natera Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the CQV Engineer opportunity with Natera at Natera.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin

cold_email.body:
Dear Natera Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Medical Science Liaison - Breast Oncology opportunity with Natera at Natera.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Sr Manager, Performance Analytics & Insights, Oncology — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Pfizer Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Sr Manager, Performance Analytics & Insights, Oncology opportunity with Pfizer at Pfizer.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

jobs.description: POSITION SUMMARY: The Senior Research Associate performs research and/or development tasks in collaboration with others. Makes detailed observations, analyzes data, and interprets results. Investigates creates and develops new methods and technologies for project advancement. Maintains a high level of professional expertise through familiarity with scientific literature. PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES: Design, plan, and perform experiments geared towards the development of non-invasive prenatal tests and cancer detection tests. Autonomously and accurately plan and execute complex laboratory experiments Analyze data using advanced analytical tools Keep a detailed laboratory notebook; write protocols and experimental plans, and document results and scientific interpretations Contribute insight toward experimental findings and troubleshoot laboratory processes and protocols Communicate and discuss results with a multidisciplinary team including biologists, bioinformaticians, statisticians, software engineers, and managers Summarize work in research reports and laboratory meeting presentations Learn and understand the science behind ongoing research projects while simultaneously completing increasingly complex tasks. This role will have occasional access to PHI both in paper and electronic form and have occasional access to various technologies to access PHI (paper and electronic) in order to perform the job. The employee must complete training relating to HIPAA/PHI privacy, General Policies and Procedure Compliance training and security training as soon as possible but not later than the first 30 days of hire. Must maintain a current status on Natera training requirements. QUALIFICATIONS: B.S. degree in molecular biology, related field, or equivalent. Minimum of 3 - 4 years of industry experience in an assay development department. KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES: Extensive hands-on experience with nucleic acid techniques, including DNA manipulation, PCR, qPCR, DNA quantification, and analysis using LabChip and BioAnalyzer. Experience with Next Generation Sequencing (NGS) techniques and protocols. Knowledge and experience in target enrichment, cfDNA/RNA, and NGS data analysis. Automation skill set is a must, including experience with developing or executing assays on automated liquid handling platforms. jobs.title: Strategy & Analytics Lead
jobs.description: ABOUT US: AI NEEDS A NEW INFRASTRUCTURE LAYER. WE'RE BUILDING IT AT MODAL. Every era of computing brought new workloads that previous infrastructure couldn't support: mainframes, databases, and the cloud. Each time, the company that rebuilt the layer underneath defined the decade. AI is no different, except it touches everything instead of one slice, and the window to build the layer underneath it is open right now. Our customers include category-defining companies like Ramp https://modal.com/blog/how-ramp-built-a-full-context-background-coding-agent-on-modal, Cognition, DoorDash, and Suno. They rely on Modal for instant GPU access, sub-second container starts, and native storage, so it's simple to serve low-latency inference, fine-tune models, and access production-ready sandboxes at scale. We've passed $1B in annualized run rate, up 15x from a year ago. In October 2026 we raised a $750M Series D led by Accel at a $15.75B valuation. Our team includes creators of popular open-source projects (e.g.,Seaborn https://github.com/mwaskom/seaborn,Luigi https://github.com/spotify/luigi), academic researchers, international olympiad medalists, and experienced engineering and product leaders with decades of experience. THE ROLE: As Strategy & Analytics Lead, you will build and lead the function that gives Modal a single, trusted picture of how the business is performing, and turn that picture into better decisions. This is a company-wide role, not a single-team one. You will support leadership across Go-to-Market, Finance, Product, and Infrastructure, own the metrics that matter most, and be a core contributor to how we plan, allocate capacity, and report to our board. This is a player-coach role. You will stay hands-on in the data while building a small, high-caliber team and the standards it works by. You will work directly with company leadership and have a large say in how Modal runs. WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON: Own the metrics that matter most - Define, document, and maintain Modal’s core company metrics, such as revenue, usage, growth, retention, margin, and capacity utilization, in partnership with Finance, Product, and Infrastructure - Create one trusted source for each metric, retire conflicting reports, and make sure leaders across the company are working from the same numbers - Build the dashboards and operating reviews that leadership uses to run the business week to week Board and executive reporting - Own the analytics behind the board package and other investor materials, from the underlying data to the charts and narrative - Make executive and board reporting accurate, repeatable, and fast to produce, with clear explanations of what changed and why - Prepare deep dives on the questions leadership and the board care most about Capacity planning and allocation - Build the analytics that inform how Modal plans, prioritizes, and allocates GPU capacity across customers and workloads - Forecast demand, track utilization and efficiency across the fleet, and help leadership weigh decisions about bringing new capacity online - Give the team clear, data-backed inputs for prioritization decisions when demand is high, so those decisions are consistent and defensible Go-to-Market analytics - Support forecasting, pipeline reviews, and account planning with reliable data on pipeline, conversion, and win rates - Analyze how usage turns into revenue, including expansion, retention, and churn, across our usage-based and committed customers - Track forecast accuracy and explain misses, and help Sales focus on the accounts with the most potential Strategic analysis across the business - Lead analyses on pricing, unit economics, product adoption, and customer cohorts, and turn them into clear recommendations - Partner with Product on usage and adoption metrics, and with Finance on reconciling usage, revenue, and margin - Answer the hard, ambiguous questions that cut across teams, and follow up on whether the recommendations worked Data foundations and team - Work with Data Engineering on reliable, well-documented data models and quality checks across product, billing, CRM, and infrastructure data - Hire and coach a small team of analysts, and set the bar for rigor, documentation, and speed - Use AI and agentic tools in day-to-day analysis, and help the team and the rest of the company do the same YOU MAY BE A FIT IF: - You have 8+ years in analytics, business intelligence, strategy, or strategic finance, including several years supporting senior leadership at a high-growth technology company - You have a track record of defining company-level metrics with Finance and Product and getting an organization to trust them - You have experience preparing board, investor, or executive reporting - You have experience analyzing usage-based or hybrid commit-plus-usage business models - You have advanced SQL and BI skills, and comfort with statistical or forecasting models - You have experience leading or coaching analysts while staying hands-on yourself - You have strong business judgment: you can turn a messy question into a clear recommendation and challenge assumptions with data - You have excellent written and verbal communication for executive audiences NICE-TO-HAVE: - Experience at a cloud infrastructure, AI infrastructure, or developer platform company - Experience with capacity planning, supply and demand forecasting, or operations analytics - Experience building a metrics or semantic layer with modern analytics-engineering tools - Experience during a period of hypergrowth - Familiarity with Salesforce, billing, and product usage data

cold_email.subject: Interest in Sr Associate, Core Solutions Sustainment. — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Pfizer Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Sr Associate, Core Solutions Sustainment. opportunity with Pfizer at Pfizer.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin

jobs.description: WHY HARVEY At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come. This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched. Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you. At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started. ROLE OVERVIEW We are looking for a GTM Technology Product Owner with a consultant's mindset to join the Revenue Technology team. This role will own the systems that take a customer from first qualified meeting to signed contract to accurate invoice. You will lead the way as an expert advisor as we build the quote-to-cash (Q2C) experience for a seat and usage-based business, using agentic applications and bespoke tooling that reflect Harvey's unique position in a rapidly evolving industry. The ideal candidate has 8+ years of experience at the intersection of technology and business operations, with a background in consulting or a high-growth B2B SaaS environment. You will operate as an advisor and owner for our Q2C stack, with a deep focus on the pricing, contracting and metering layers. This is a role for a problem solver who has a bias for action and enjoys the challenge of building systems that eliminate friction across the deal lifecycle. You will be comfortable operating with high ownership and the ability to navigate complex requirements from multiple business units. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Roadmap Ownership: Own the Q2C product roadmap end to end, from pricing and packaging through quoting, contracting, approvals, order capture and the handoff to billing. Partner with Sales, Deal Desk, Legal and Finance to translate business objectives into technical requirements, serving as both project liaison and lead analyst. Operate with extreme urgency and agency once prioritization has been agreed upon with leadership. - Headless CPQ & Pricing Architecture: Define how pricing, products and discounting logic live in an API-first, headless CPQ layer so that sellers and agents can all quote from the same source of truth. - Contracting, Deal Desk & Approvals: Own the connection between quotes and contracts. Design approval matrices, discount governance and non-standard term workflows that keep deals moving fast while protecting margin and compliance. - Usage-Based Metering: Partner with Billing, Engineering and Revenue Accounting to define how metered usage maps to entitlements, credits and invoices, and how that data is surfaced back to sales, customers and finance. - Data & Agentic Processes: Leverage AI agents and tools to streamline quote creation, deal review and contract workflows. Work closely with managers and ICs across functions to provide expert level advice about what AI is ready to do, and what should be left to humans. - Cross-Functional Partnership: Act as a liaison between Sales, Deal Desk, Legal, Finance, RevOps, Enablement, and GTM Systems to deliver a best in class user experience. Guide strategic evaluations of projects and platforms to help leadership make informed decisions on prioritization. - Systems Governance: Manage data integrity and system audits across the Q2C stack. You will document our evolving data models and process flows to ensure we remain scalable as we double in size, and verify that the tools we have adopted are driving ROI. WHAT YOU HAVE - Experience: 8+ years as a Product Owner, Product Manager, or Systems Architect, with deep ownership of quote-to-cash or quote-to-order systems. Background in consulting or a high-growth B2B tech company is required. - Headless CPQ: Familiarity with headless, API-first CPQ applications and how they differ from traditional UI-bound CPQ. You can explain tradeoffs in product catalog, pricing rules and quote APIs. - Contracting Systems: Hands-on experience with contracting systems (CLM or equivalent) and how they connect to quoting, approvals and downstream systems. - Deal Desk & Approvals: Working knowledge of deal desk operations, discount governance and multi-step approval design. - Usage-Based Metering: Experience with usage-based or consumption pricing, including metering, rating, entitlements and how usage reaches billing and the general ledger. - AI Expertise: Ability to demonstrate a portfolio of AI first principles. You will be expected to both explain the technical nature of different models and platforms, and show micro-apps you have built on agentic applications. - The "Glue" Tech: Proven experience understanding the relationship between technology and users. Strong ability to extrapolate data structures across platforms into a baseline that can be used by both end users and agents. - Analytical Chops: Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills and experience with BI tools. Experience with integration patterns for data warehouses and reverse ETL tooling. - Consultative Approach: Exceptional ability to gather requirements from non-technical stakeholders and transform them into elegant, scalable technical solutions. Track record of iteration with technical development teams and delivering projects from inception to hypercare. BONUS POINTS (OPTIONAL) - Experience migrating from a legacy CPQ to a modern or headless architecture. - Familiarity with ASC 606 and SOX compliance, and the revenue accounting implications of usage-based contracts. - Experience as part of a hypergrowth company, building a business function 0 > 1. jobs.title: Deal Strategy & Operations Lead
jobs.description: ABOUT US: AI NEEDS A NEW INFRASTRUCTURE LAYER. WE'RE BUILDING IT AT MODAL. Every era of computing brought new workloads that previous infrastructure couldn't support: mainframes, databases, and the cloud. Each time, the company that rebuilt the layer underneath defined the decade. AI is no different, except it touches everything instead of one slice, and the window to build the layer underneath it is open right now. Our customers include category-defining companies like Ramp https://modal.com/blog/how-ramp-built-a-full-context-background-coding-agent-on-modal, Cognition, DoorDash, and Suno. They rely on Modal for instant GPU access, sub-second container starts, and native storage, so it's simple to serve low-latency inference, fine-tune models, and access production-ready sandboxes at scale. We've passed $1B in annualized run rate, up 15x from a year ago. In October 2026 we raised a $750M Series D led by Accel at a $15.75B valuation. Our team includes creators of popular open-source projects (e.g.,Seaborn https://github.com/mwaskom/seaborn,Luigi https://github.com/spotify/luigi), academic researchers, international olympiad medalists, and experienced engineering and product leaders with decades of experience. THE ROLE: Our largest customers are running more workloads on Modal than ever, and their deals are getting bigger and more creative. Increasingly, every major deal involves a pricing decision, a capacity decision, and a contract decision at the same time. As the Deal Strategy & Operations Lead, you will own the commercial structure and economics of Modal’s largest and most complex deals from first proposal to signed contract. You will design deal structures that fit how customers actually use compute, work directly with customers on the terms that matter, set the guardrails that protect margin, and make sure what we sell lines up with what we can deliver. Your job is to help us close fast without giving away the economics. You will work closely with Sales, Finance, Legal, Product, and Infrastructure. This is a chance to build Modal’s deal strategy function from the ground up, with a lot of scope and direct exposure to leadership. WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON: Deal strategy and structuring - Partner with Sales on Modal’s most strategic accounts to structure multi-workload, multi-year agreements - Design deals around how each customer’s usage actually behaves, blending flexible on-demand compute with committed and guaranteed capacity where it makes sense - Turn technical requirements into commercial terms, and adjust those terms as customers grow - Structure ramps, commitments, renewals, and other non-standard terms that help customers make Modal their primary platform Customer negotiations - Join late-stage negotiations alongside Sales and represent Modal directly with customers’ finance, procurement, and engineering leaders - Explain the reasoning behind our pricing in ways that build trust, and know when to hold firm and when to trade Pricing and commercial policy - Own the discounting framework, approval thresholds, and escalation paths for non-standard deals - Work with Product, Finance, and leadership to shape pricing and packaging for new products and hardware - Track deal outcomes and the competitive landscape, and turn what you learn into recommendations on pricing, packaging, and policy Capacity-aware dealmaking - Connect the commercial pipeline to infrastructure planning so the commitments we make are commitments we can keep - Help shape how Modal makes fair, consistent capacity decisions as demand grows Deal desk operations - Run the day-to-day flow of strategic deals, reviewing non-standard requests and keeping approvals moving - Build the playbooks, templates, and workflows (with RevOps, in Salesforce and CPQ) that let Sales move quickly without an exception on every deal. Use AI and automation heavily so the function scales - Work with Legal, Accounting, RevOps, and Billing so deals are contracted, booked, billed, and recognized correctly Deal economics and analytics - Model deal profitability, margin, and the impact of discounts and terms, and bring clear recommendations to leadership on the deals that matter most - Track and report on the health of the function: deal velocity, approval turnaround, pricing discipline, and booking accuracy YOU MAY BE A FIT IF: - You have 5+ years in deal strategy, deal desk, pricing, strategic finance, investing, or revenue operations at a high-growth company, including several years structuring complex, non-standard deals - You have a track record of negotiating directly with customers on large deals, and the commercial judgment to know which terms matter - You have a deep understanding of usage-based pricing: commitments, drawdowns, tiered discounts, true-ups, and multi-year agreements. Experience with committed-capacity models is a strong plus - You have strong financial modeling skills. You are comfortable reasoning about unit economics, utilization, and margin tradeoffs - You have a working understanding of how deal terms flow through to billing and revenue recognition - You are able to act as both architect and operator: you can design the framework and then run the deal through it the same afternoon - You are able to influence senior leaders across Sales, Finance, and Legal, with crisp written and verbal communication for executive audiences - You are comfortable with ambiguity and building process from nothing in a fast-moving environment - You have proficiency with Salesforce and CPQ tools, and an instinct to automate anything you do more than twice NICE-TO-HAVE: - Experience at a cloud infrastructure, GPU, or AI infrastructure company - Familiarity with GPU and compute economics - Experience building a deal desk or deal strategy function from scratch at a high-growth company - Enough technical fluency to talk through workload requirements with a customer’s engineers

jobs.title: Manager, GL Accounting
jobs.description: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. Available Locations: IN Bengaluru About the role The Manager, GL Accounting - India, is a vital leadership role responsible for the day-to-day execution, supervision, and efficiency of the GL Accounting Team based in India. This is a critical operational role where you will directly influence the quality, speed, and accuracy of our core accounting processes. You will serve as the primary on-the-ground manager, ensuring the India-based team maintains high performance (SLAs) , resolves issues efficiently, and provides necessary support to our core operational close processes. Working closely with the US-based Director, Managers and Supervisors, you will translate global process standards into effective local practice, supervise weekly and month-end closing tasks, and ensure the team is prepared to support ongoing global projects and process improvement initiatives. What you'll do: Execution, Support, and Quality Control Workforce Management & Team Leadership: Provide direct supervision and mentorship to the India-based GL operations teams, fostering a culture of high performance, accountability, and continuous improvement within the contracted workforce model. Month-End Close Execution: Scale the team to achieve full, autonomous ownership of month-end close accounting processes (e.g. cash, accruals, foreign payroll). Post-Close Execution & Analysis: Own post-close execution, including timely balance sheet reconciliations and variance (flux) analysis. Process Improvement & Project Support: Partner with the US-based team to support ongoing finance transformation projects (including the ERP implementation) and process improvement initiatives. Compliance & Control Execution: Ensure the local team adheres strictly to the defined internal controls, maintaining effective documentation and evidence to support robust SOX compliance and external audit requirements. Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience Technical Expertise: Public accounting audit experience in a managerial role required; Big 4 firm strongly preferred. Certification: CPA, or international equivalent, is required. Experience: 10+ years of progressive experience in an accounting or auditing role is required. Problem Solving: Demonstrated ability to make sound decisions and manage multiple high-priority deliverables and work streams simultaneously in a fast-paced environment. Team Leadership & Communication: Exceptional leadership skills with the ability to manage performance, train junior staff, and communicate complex issues clearly across different cultures and time zones. Detail Orientation: Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills, with a track record of proactively identifying and resolving operational bottlenecks. Project Management: Proven ability to organize, & manage projects from inception to completion that require coordinated efforts across multiple functional areas (Accounting, FP&A, Treasury, Operations). Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills; must be comfortable connecting and communicating with individuals at all levels of the organization. Control Environment: Strong knowledge of SOX requirements , including the ability to assess, develop, and implement internal controls. Mindset: Proactive and creative approach, strong analytical skills, and ability to navigate ambiguous situations, bringing options and providing clear recommendations. Education: Bachelor’s Degree in accounting or related field. Systems Proficiency: Proficient in Word, Excel, Alteryx, OpenCode, and PowerPoint. What Makes Cloudflare Special? We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet. Project Galileo : Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost. Athenian Project : In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states. 1.1.1.1 : We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers. Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you! Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs. More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process. This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license. cold_email.body:
Dear Pfizer Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the [MA] RA/Gastroenterology, Medical Affairs Scientist, Medical Manager/Associate（office-based medical） opportunity with Pfizer at Pfizer.

I am especially interested in the group's effort to integrate multi-omic and clinical data with AI for biomarker and therapeutic discovery. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in bioinformatics, pipeline development, and an LLM-assisted competency-mapping project has made me especially interested in rigorous, interpretable AI for biomedical data.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
