jobs.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the Role As a member of the Compute Capacity Strategy & Operations team, you will own initiatives that support Anthropic's compute capacity planning and management. You will collaborate closely with our Inference, Finance & Strategy, and Capacity Engineering teams to optimize resource utilization and create a best-in-class customer experience for Anthropic’s users. Responsibilities: Help onboard new compute into the inference serving stack Create systems and runbooks to maximize the business value of our compute fleetwide and ensure traffic is prioritized correctly Partner with a wide variety of cross-functional stakeholder teams to make complex decisions about how we can best deploy and manage accelerator capacity Help design and implement new inference serving strategies that unlock commercial value Tackle ambiguous but critical strategic questions related to compute capacity with rigorous attention to detail, sound judgment, and clear delivery of actionable insights Gather and synthesize quantitative and qualitative data into clear, actionable recommendations that inform priorities and decision-making You might be a good fit if you: Have 8+ years of experience in operations, product management, technical program management, or similar roles in high-performing tech companies Approach every challenge with intellectual curiosity, attention to detail, and unwavering commitment to Anthropic's mission of developing safe and beneficial AI Have a combination of strong analytical skills and willingness to dive deep into the operational details of novel problems Are able to convey complicated, technical topics in simple terms for direct teammates up to executive leadership Have strong communication skills and can effectively engage with both technical and non-technical stakeholders Are highly organized and can manage multiple parallel workstreams effectively The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $290,000 — $320,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. jobs.description: Use Your Power for Purpose At Pfizer, technology impacts everything we do. Our digital and 'data first' strategy focuses on implementing impactful and innovative technology solutions across all functions, from research to manufacturing. Your dedication and hard work will be instrumental in helping Pfizer achieve new milestones and make a positive impact on patients worldwide. As Manager, Forward Deployed Engineer, you join a Finance & GBS function team, learn how the work gets done, and build AI that changes it. You own the full path: problem discovery, prototype, MVP, production handoff and support. You learn the process, and you write the code. You work on engagements in areas such as financial close, forecasting, accounts receivable, procure-to-pay, tax, treasury, shared services operations, and other F&GBS functions. We measure success through adoption and demonstrable business outcomes, including time saved and adoption, improved quality, reduced risk, stronger controls, faster cycle times, better decisions, and measurable financial impact. This is a hands-on individual contributor role within the F&GBS Technology & AI Solutions Capability Center in Chennai. You work alongside Product Owners, function leaders, finance analysts, process owners, and Digital platform teams. WHY THIS ROLE · You work directly with Finance and GBS teams worldwide, so you find out fast whether what you build works. · You build agentic AI with frontier models on Pfizer’s enterprise AI platforms, connected to SAP, Snowflake, Oracle EPM and custom solutions through MCP or direct API integration. · You help build and expand a shared F&GBS Data & AI Foundation (ontology, rules engine, MCP tool library, and decision ledger), so future agents don’t start from scratch. · You can grow into a Senior Manager technical lead role without moving into people management. ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES Problem Discovery & Business Embedding · Work in person in Chennai alongside a F&GBS Technology & AI Solutions Capability Center, while embedding virtually with an assigned Finance or GBS team. Learn the work through regular calls, screen-share walkthroughs, and process reviews, map the process, and find where AI removes effort, risk, or delay. · Run discovery with business users and process owners across regions, including the US and Europe. · Translate business pain points into scoped use cases with success measures agreed with the business owner. · Work from Product Owner priorities and specifications, and shape them into buildable scope with the business owner. · Push back when the request doesn’t match the underlying problem or it’s exposed to technical issues and limitation. Build & Ship · Build agentic AI solutions end to end: agents and tools on Azure AI Foundry, Vertex AI, other market leading runtimes and Microsoft Agent Framework, Lang Graph, LangChain, MCP tool integrations, retrieval with Azure AI Search, document extraction with Document Intelligence, and the interfaces users touch. · Deliver working prototypes in days and MVPs in weeks. Iterate directly with end users. · Write production-quality code in Python and TypeScript/JavaScript, with tests, version control, and code review. · Use AI coding agents in your daily workflow, and review AI-generated code to the same standard as your own. · Build evaluation sets that prove accuracy on real finance data before release, and run them as regression tests on every change. Data & Enterprise Integration · Connect solutions to enterprise Finance and GBS data and systems through governed MCP tools (or API) and certified data products, such as SAP S/4HANA, Snowflake (including Cortex), Databricks, SAP Ariba and Business Network, Oracle EPM, Microsoft 365, and other enterprise platforms. · Write and tune SQL. Use and extend the shared F&GBS ontology, semantic views, and business rules instead of hard-coding logic in prompts. · Follow data access, entitlement, and classification rules for financial and personal data. Controls, Compliance & Responsible AI · Design solutions that hold up to SOX, Internal Audit, data privacy (GDPR, India DPDP Act), and EU AI Act review. Record agent evidence, approvals, and actions in the decision ledger, and build human review steps where AI outputs drive financial decisions. · Apply Pfizer responsible AI safeguards: data access controls, prompt injection defenses, and output monitoring. · Document design decisions, data lineage, and model behavior for control owners. Production & Handoff · Own production readiness and ongoing support: LLMOps practice, deployment pipelines, monitoring, incident response, and run costs. · Establish support ownership, runbooks, service expectations, escalation paths, knowledge transfer, and root cause analysis for production solutions. · Deploy through approved pipelines on Pfizer cloud and GenAI platforms. Set up logging, tracing, monitoring, and alerting with Azure Monitor, Application Insights, and Foundry Observability. · Contribute reusable components and patterns to the team’s shared library. Value & Adoption · Track usage, accuracy, and hours saved. Report results to the business owner and FDE leadership. · Train users and build champions in the business so adoption sticks. BASIC QUALIFICATIONS You can partner with the business, turn messy problems into working solutions, and show the impact in numbers. · Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field, with [6+] years of software or data engineering experience. · 3+ years building LLM-based applications, including RAG, tool calling, or agents, with at least one solution in use by business users. · Experience evaluating and testing LLM output quality. · Hands-on Python coding at a production standard. Working knowledge of TypeScript/JavaScript and a modern web framework such as React. · Strong SQL and experience working with enterprise data platforms. · Hands-on experience with Azure (preferred) or AWS cloud services, API design, and CI/CD. · Track record of working directly with business users to define and deliver solutions. · Clear written and verbal communication with non-technical stakeholders. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS · Master’s degree in a technical field, or a finance/accounting background combined with engineering experience. · Working knowledge of finance processes such as record-to-report, order-to-cash, procure-to-pay, or FP&A. · Experience with SAP data structures, Snowflake (including Cortex), or the Azure AI stack (AI Foundry, AI Search, Document Intelligence, Azure ML). · Experience with agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., Microsoft Agent Framework, LangGraph), MCP, and vector search. · Exposure to ontologies, knowledge graphs, or rules engines. · Experience in a regulated industry, with exposure to SOX or IT general controls. · Relevant certifications (AWS or Azure Developer or Solutions Architect or other market leading runtimes). You don’t need every item on this list. If you’ve shipped AI that people use and you want to work close to the business, we want to hear from you. NON-STANDARD WORK SCHEDULE, TRAVEL, OR ENVIRONMENT REQUIREMENTS · Regular overlap with US and European time zones is required, including some early-evening IST calls. · Must be able to travel to Pfizer offices and partner sites when required, including occasional international travel. · Work can be demanding at times, including support during period-end close or response to production incidents. jobs.description: WHY HARVEY At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come. This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched. Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you. At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started. ROLE OVERVIEW We are looking for a GTM Technology Product Owner with a consultant's mindset to join the Revenue Technology team. This role will own the systems that take a customer from first qualified meeting to signed contract to accurate invoice. You will lead the way as an expert advisor as we build the quote-to-cash (Q2C) experience for a seat and usage-based business, using agentic applications and bespoke tooling that reflect Harvey's unique position in a rapidly evolving industry. The ideal candidate has 8+ years of experience at the intersection of technology and business operations, with a background in consulting or a high-growth B2B SaaS environment. You will operate as an advisor and owner for our Q2C stack, with a deep focus on the pricing, contracting and metering layers. This is a role for a problem solver who has a bias for action and enjoys the challenge of building systems that eliminate friction across the deal lifecycle. You will be comfortable operating with high ownership and the ability to navigate complex requirements from multiple business units. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Roadmap Ownership: Own the Q2C product roadmap end to end, from pricing and packaging through quoting, contracting, approvals, order capture and the handoff to billing. Partner with Sales, Deal Desk, Legal and Finance to translate business objectives into technical requirements, serving as both project liaison and lead analyst. Operate with extreme urgency and agency once prioritization has been agreed upon with leadership. - Headless CPQ & Pricing Architecture: Define how pricing, products and discounting logic live in an API-first, headless CPQ layer so that sellers and agents can all quote from the same source of truth. - Contracting, Deal Desk & Approvals: Own the connection between quotes and contracts. Design approval matrices, discount governance and non-standard term workflows that keep deals moving fast while protecting margin and compliance. - Usage-Based Metering: Partner with Billing, Engineering and Revenue Accounting to define how metered usage maps to entitlements, credits and invoices, and how that data is surfaced back to sales, customers and finance. - Data & Agentic Processes: Leverage AI agents and tools to streamline quote creation, deal review and contract workflows. Work closely with managers and ICs across functions to provide expert level advice about what AI is ready to do, and what should be left to humans. - Cross-Functional Partnership: Act as a liaison between Sales, Deal Desk, Legal, Finance, RevOps, Enablement, and GTM Systems to deliver a best in class user experience. Guide strategic evaluations of projects and platforms to help leadership make informed decisions on prioritization. - Systems Governance: Manage data integrity and system audits across the Q2C stack. You will document our evolving data models and process flows to ensure we remain scalable as we double in size, and verify that the tools we have adopted are driving ROI. WHAT YOU HAVE - Experience: 8+ years as a Product Owner, Product Manager, or Systems Architect, with deep ownership of quote-to-cash or quote-to-order systems. Background in consulting or a high-growth B2B tech company is required. - Headless CPQ: Familiarity with headless, API-first CPQ applications and how they differ from traditional UI-bound CPQ. You can explain tradeoffs in product catalog, pricing rules and quote APIs. - Contracting Systems: Hands-on experience with contracting systems (CLM or equivalent) and how they connect to quoting, approvals and downstream systems. - Deal Desk & Approvals: Working knowledge of deal desk operations, discount governance and multi-step approval design. - Usage-Based Metering: Experience with usage-based or consumption pricing, including metering, rating, entitlements and how usage reaches billing and the general ledger. - AI Expertise: Ability to demonstrate a portfolio of AI first principles. You will be expected to both explain the technical nature of different models and platforms, and show micro-apps you have built on agentic applications. - The "Glue" Tech: Proven experience understanding the relationship between technology and users. Strong ability to extrapolate data structures across platforms into a baseline that can be used by both end users and agents. - Analytical Chops: Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills and experience with BI tools. Experience with integration patterns for data warehouses and reverse ETL tooling. - Consultative Approach: Exceptional ability to gather requirements from non-technical stakeholders and transform them into elegant, scalable technical solutions. Track record of iteration with technical development teams and delivering projects from inception to hypercare. BONUS POINTS (OPTIONAL) - Experience migrating from a legacy CPQ to a modern or headless architecture. - Familiarity with ASC 606 and SOX compliance, and the revenue accounting implications of usage-based contracts. - Experience as part of a hypergrowth company, building a business function 0 > 1. jobs.description: ABOUT ABRIDGE Founded in 2018, Abridge is the first AI-native clinician intelligence platform organized around the patient, built for clinicians, and designed to help health systems coordinate the clinical, financial, and evidence-based decisions for every moment of care. Powered by purpose-built AI for healthcare, Abridge connects patients, providers, payers, and life sciences companies. This year, the platform will support more than 100 million patient-clinician conversations across more than 300 of the largest and most complex health systems in the U.S. With deep workflow integration, the Abridge clinician intelligence platform has been validated to support encounters in 28+ languages across specialties and care settings. Abridge is setting the industry standard for the responsible deployment of Al across health systems with continual and transparent Al evaluation. Clinical decision support references and cites gold-standard sources of evidence, and features like Linked Evidence map AI-generated documentation to source data, helping clinicians quickly trust and verify the output. Abridge was awarded Best in KLAS for Ambient AI in 2025 and 2026, in addition to other accolades, including TIME Best Inventions of 2024 and 2025, CNBC Disruptor 2025, and Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies 2025. We are a growing team of practicing clinicians, AI scientists, PhDs, creatives, technologists, and engineers working together to transform healthcare. We have offices located in San Francisco, New York, and Pittsburgh. THE ROLE We're looking for Software Engineering Interns to join Abridge's Engineering team for a 3-month internship program for Summer 2027 with the possibility of extension. You'll collaborate with our engineering team to build and ship real-world features that translate cutting-edge language model capabilities into dependable clinical systems. With mentorship and guidance, you'll gain hands-on experience designing, coding, and releasing AI-powered software that makes a meaningful impact on clinicians' workflows. What You'll Do - Design and build end-to-end features, enhancing our existing systems and contributing to agentic LLM workflows (retrieval pipelines, structured tool use, chained LLM calls) - Fix user-facing bugs and issues, and make quality-of-life improvements across our backend and frontend systems - Get hands-on with evaluation frameworks that measure accuracy, robustness, and clinical reliability - Help prototype with new models, prompting techniques, and open-source orchestration tools (LangChain, LlamaIndex, etc.) - Develop a strong user-centric mindset, building empathy for Abridge's clinicians and the challenges they face - Collaborate across cross-functional product teams — design, product, machine learning, and infrastructure — to ship features to our customers - Receive guidance from an experienced software engineering mentor, and collaborate one-on-one with teammates within your pod What You'll Bring - A strong interest in pursuing a full-time software engineering role in 2027 or 2028 — high-performing interns are eligible to receive a return offer - AI tooling is already part of how you work — you use it to write, debug, and learn faster, and you know when to trust it vs. verify - Passion for and understanding of Abridge's mission - A curious, adaptable, and proactive mindset, with a desire to learn and grow in a fast-paced startup environment - A collaborative, low-ego mindset — we move fast, and we need team players who are eager to contribute wherever needed Base Salary: $40/hr Must be willing to work from our San Francisco (Potrero) office 5x per week. This internship is based in our San Francisco office. Relocation to SF will be supported through reimbursements. WHY WORK AT ABRIDGE? At Abridge, we’re transforming healthcare delivery experiences with generative AI, enabling clinicians and patients to connect in deeper, more meaningful ways. Our mission is clear: to power deeper understanding in healthcare. We’re driving real, lasting change, with millions of medical conversations processed each month. Joining Abridge means stepping into a fast-paced, high-growth startup where your contributions truly make a difference. Our culture requires extreme ownership—every employee has the ability to (and is expected to) make an impact on our customers and our business. Beyond individual impact, you will have the opportunity to work alongside a team of curious, high-achieving people in a supportive environment where success is shared, growth is constant, and feedback fuels progress. At Abridge, it’s not just what we do—it’s how we do it. Every decision is rooted in empathy, always prioritizing the needs of clinicians and patients. We’re committed to supporting your growth, both professionally and personally. Whether it's flexible work hours, an inclusive culture, or ongoing learning opportunities, we are here to help you thrive and do the best work of your life. If you are ready to make a meaningful impact alongside passionate people who care deeply about what they do, Abridge is the place for you. jobs.title: Workplace Operations Manager – Singapore
jobs.description: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. Available Locations Singapore About the Role The Places Team at Cloudflare is seeking an experienced, operationally rigorous Workplace Operations Manager to lead daily onsite workplace operations for our Singapore office. In this role, you will serve as the hands-on operational site lead and brand ambassador, driving workplace standards, executing regional directives, and delivering a consistent, high-touch employee and guest experience across our APAC hub. Reporting directly to the Regional Workplace Operations Manager – APAC, you will translate regional strategy into efficient site execution. You will partner with regional leadership, cross-functional teams (IT, Physical Security, People Operations, Legal), and local service partners to maintain a highly functional, welcoming workplace. Balancing local site ownership with regional alignment, you bring practical expertise in facilities coordination, end-to-end vendor lifecycle management (including RFPs and contract reviews), and budget tracking, paired with a hospitality mindset that reflects Cloudflare’s values and culture. Responsibilities Lead Onsite Hub Operations & Space Readiness: Direct daily workplace operations across the Singapore site—overseeing front-of-house services, shipping/receiving, routine building maintenance, and space readiness to maintain an organized, welcoming workplace. Vendor Management, RFPs & Contract Renewals: Manage the full vendor lifecycle across janitorial, catering, and facilities services. Build collaborative vendor relationships, lead local RFP processes, track SLA performance, and conduct service reviews to drive contract renewals. Site Budget Tracking & Expense Management: Monitor and track the local operating expense (OpEx) budget in partnership with APAC leadership. Review invoices, manage POs, track monthly spend, and identify cost efficiencies. Workplace Experience & Programs: Champion workplace culture and hybrid collaboration by delivering regional workplace programs, high-touch onsite initiatives, and day-to-day food, beverage, and amenity offerings. Site Communications & Operational Insights: Act as the primary operational contact for Singapore site leadership and staff. Monitor and report workplace metrics (occupancy, space utilization, ticketing trends) to inform space planning and escalate site risks. Internal Events & Onsite Logistics: Coordinate logistics and day-of execution for onsite gatherings, executive visits, team offsites, and cultural celebrations in partnership with Global Events and IT. Safety, Compliance & Emergency Readiness: Coordinate onsite facility safety and compliance in partnership with Global Physical Security and property management, ensuring alignment with Singapore WSH risk assessments and SCDF emergency response standards. Team Direction & Site Support: Supervise day-to-day workflows for workplace contractors and coordinators, serving as the local operational partner for regional real estate project refreshes and regional coverage. Regional Collaboration: Participate actively in regional operations syncs, sharing local operational insights, supporting peer site coverage across APJC, and ensuring consistent policy rollouts within the region. Requirements 5+ years of workplace or facilities operations experience , preferably within a high-growth tech or fast-paced corporate environment. 1–2+ years of supervisory or team lead experience , managing onsite workplace staff, coordinators, or contractor teams. Proven vendor management and RFP experience , including running competitive bidding, monitoring SLAs, managing partner relationships, and driving contract renewal reviews. Operational budget tracking skills , with practical experience reviewing vendor invoices, managing POs, and monitoring site OpEx. Cross-functional communication skills , with the ability to communicate operational updates confidently across time zones using Google Workspace and modern ticketing platforms. Knowledge of Singapore safety standards , including MOM Workplace Safety and Health (WSH) guidelines and emergency response protocols. Hospitality mindset & hands-on problem solving , dedicated to delivering high operational standards in an employee-centric environment. Onsite presence: Required to be onsite full-time, 5 days per week at our Singapore office. What Makes Cloudflare Special? We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet. Project Galileo : Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost. Athenian Project : In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states. 1.1.1.1 : We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers. Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you! Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs. More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process. This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license. Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer. Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment. If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at hr@cloudflare.com or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.

jobs.title: Privacy Operations Analyst
jobs.description: About the Team Regulatory & Privacy Operations sits within User Safety & Risk Operations (USRO), part of OpenAI’s broader User Operations organization. We build and run the operational programs that protect user rights and support OpenAI’s legal, regulatory & privacy obligations across its products and developer tools. We partner with Legal, Privacy Engineering, Product, Policy, Governance, Risk & Compliance, Support Operations, and external vendors to resolve sensitive cases and build reliable, scalable operations. Our remit spans privacy, online safety, AI regulation, and intellectual property. About the Role We are seeking an experienced Privacy Operations Analyst to own and evolve our global Privacy Operations workstream from Dublin. This individual contributor role combines hands-on management of complex privacy matters with accountability for operational health, vendor quality, and program improvement. You will take end-to-end ownership of how privacy rights requests are received, assessed, routed, and resolved across a tiered operating model. You will partner closely with Privacy Legal, the Data Protection Officer’s office, Privacy Engineering, and operations teams to translate legal guidance into practical workflows and resolve issues that cross organizational boundaries. Beyond keeping operations healthy, you will set priorities and deliver improvements that reduce avoidable demand, strengthen controls, and enable safe automation. We are looking for someone who independently identifies problems, makes sound decisions with incomplete information, and carries work from diagnosis through implementation and measurable results. Privacy will be your primary remit. You will also develop sufficient familiarity with adjacent Regulatory Operations workflows to recognize intersecting risks and provide secondary support when priorities require it. In This Role, You Will - Own global Privacy Operations across intake, identity verification, case handling, escalations, and closure, including access, deletion, export, correction, and opt-out requests, working within guidance agreed with Legal. - Independently investigate and resolve complex or sensitive privacy cases, including third-party requests, account restrictions, and complaints about personal information in AI outputs. Recognize when legal interpretation or technical investigation is needed and coordinate the right partners through resolution. - Own operational health across internal and vendor-supported queues. Use demand forecasts, backlog age, response and resolution times, quality, and capacity data to identify emerging risks and act before deadlines or user outcomes deteriorate. - Drive vendor performance through clear procedures, training, quality calibration, escalation criteria, and corrective actions. Expand delegated handling where appropriate, with the controls and evidence needed to maintain quality. - Build and deliver a prioritized roadmap for workflow simplification, self-service, tooling, and AI-assisted automation. Define requirements, evaluate accuracy and failure modes, establish human review and escalation safeguards, and measure impact after launch. - Translate privacy requirements and Legal guidance into standard operating procedures, decision trees, case documentation, and operational controls. Keep guidance current as products, policies, and requirements evolve. - Lead Privacy Operations readiness for product launches and policy changes. Assess likely demand, new case types, routing, capacity, and dependencies, and drive practical mitigations with cross-functional owners. - Investigate handling failures and recurring complaints, establish root causes and wider exposure, and deliver corrective actions with clear ownership and evidence of effectiveness. - Maintain reliable reporting and case records to support audit readiness, control testing, and Legal-led responses to regulatory inquiries. Communicate the risk, impact, recommendation, and decisions needed clearly to partners and leadership. - Set priorities across immediate casework and longer-term improvements, make explicit trade-offs, and influence partners across teams and time zones to deliver results. You Might Thrive in This Role If You - Have 8+ years of relevant experience in privacy operations, regulatory operations, legal operations, or a related field, with substantial hands-on ownership of privacy rights workflows in a global technology environment. - Have a strong working understanding of GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, and privacy rights operations, and can translate counsel’s guidance into consistent, usable processes. You understand the challenges of identity verification, sensitive data handling, and complex request fulfillment. - Have independently owned a complex operational program, set its priorities, and delivered improvements across multiple teams, with evidence of better quality, lower risk, faster resolution, or reduced manual work. - Have managed vendor-supported operations and tiered escalation models, including service levels, quality assurance, capacity planning, training, and performance remediation. - Bring an automation-first approach grounded in sound risk judgment. You can identify what should be automated, define how it will be evaluated, and retain appropriate oversight for sensitive decisions. - Are comfortable using operational data, dashboards, and case analysis to diagnose problems, test assumptions, and make recommendations. You can distinguish a temporary volume spike from a systemic process or control failure. - Communicate clearly and concisely, including on sensitive cases and operational risks. Your updates explain what matters, what has changed, and what action or decision is needed. - Exercise strong judgment in ambiguity, act with urgency proportionate to risk, and know when to decide independently and when to escalate. You follow through without relying on detailed direction. - Build effective relationships with Legal, Engineering, Product, and operations partners, and can influence decisions without formal authority. Additional Experience That Would Be Valuable - Experience with privacy operations for AI products, including requests involving model outputs or personal information. - Practical experience with tooling, automation evaluation, or AI-assisted quality assurance. - Familiarity with adjacent frameworks such as the DSA, OSA, or EU AI Act, and experience supporting audits or regulatory inquiries. - A relevant privacy qualification, such as CIPP/E or CIPM.
